title: God magnificently rewards this holiness
source_text: XIV. Quantopere vero Deus gratam habeat sanctitatem & justitiam quae fidelibus inest, inde patet quod ea non tantum in hoc saeculo, sed etiam in futuro magnifice remuneratur. Nam, ut ait sapiens, Justis retribuuntur bona, Prov. 13. 21. & pietas, quae sanctitate & justitia illa constat, promissiones habet non solum hujus, sed futurae vitae, ut docet Apostolus 1 Timoth. 4. 8. Quumque Deus olim vivos & mortuos judicabit, justitiae fidelium testimonium solenne perhibebit, eamque coram universo mundo laudaturus & praemiaturus est vita & gloria aeterna, quam gratuito promisit omnibus qui sanctitati & justitiae student. Nam, ut Christus ipse Dominus noster ait, Justi fulgebunt sicut sol in regno Patris sui, Matth. 13. 43. Unde est quod vita illa, & gloria aeterna vocatur ab Apostolo Corona justitiae, 2 Tim. 4. 8. Reposita est, inquit, mihi corona justitiae, quam Deus justus judex mihi reddet in die illa.
pass_a_gloss: But how greatly God holds gracious the holiness and righteousness that is in believers appears from this, that it is magnificently rewarded not only in this age but also in the age to come. For, as the wise man says, Good things are repaid to the righteous (Proverbs 13:21); and piety, which consists in that holiness and righteousness, has promises not only of this life but of the life to come, as the Apostle teaches (1 Timothy 4:8). And when God one day will judge the living and the dead, he will bear solemn testimony to the righteousness of believers, and before the whole world will praise and reward it with eternal life and glory, which he has freely promised to all who pursue holiness and righteousness. For, as Christ our Lord himself says, The righteous will shine like the sun in the kingdom of their Father (Matthew 13:43). Hence that life and eternal glory is called by the Apostle the crown of righteousness (2 Timothy 4:8): There is laid up for me, he says, a crown of righteousness, which the Lord, the righteous Judge, will give me on that day.
pass_b_english: God richly rewards this holiness now and hereafter; piety has promise of this life and the next.
At the last judgment he will solemnly attest believers' righteousness and crown it with eternal life—the crown of righteousness.

choices.why: Key lemma for De Justitia densify §1048.
